+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ValidationIssue:
+    field: str
+    code: str
+    message: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ValidationResult:
+    valid: bool
+    issues: List[ValidationIssue]
+    normalized: Dict[str, Any]
+
+
+def _get_api_key() -> str:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return api_key
+
+
+def _confidence_value(value: Any) -> Optional[float]:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return float(value)
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return float(value.strip())
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+    return None
+
+
+def _normalize_fields(data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    normalized = dict(data)
+    if "fields" not in normalized and any(k in normalized for k in ("vendor", "date", "total", "items")):
+        normalized = {"fields": normalized}
+    return normalized
+
+
+def _required_field_issues(fields: Dict[str, Any], required_fields: Sequence[str]) -> List[ValidationIssue]:
+    issues: List[ValidationIssue] = []
+    for field in required_fields:
+        value = fields.get(field)
+        if value is None or value == "" or value == [] or value == {}:
+            issues.append(ValidationIssue(field=field, code="missing_required_field", message=f"{field} is required"))
+    return issues
+
+
+def _confidence_issues(fields: Dict[str, Any], required_fields: Sequence[str], min_confidence: float) -> List[ValidationIssue]:
+    issues: List[ValidationIssue] = []
+    for field in required_fields:
+        confidence = _confidence_value(fields.get(f"{field}_confidence", fields.get("confidence")))
+        if confidence is None:
+            issues.append(ValidationIssue(field=field, code="missing_confidence", message=f"{field} confidence is required"))
+        elif confidence < min_confidence:
+            issues.append(ValidationIssue(field=field, code="low_confidence", message=f"{field} confidence below threshold"))
+    return issues
+
+
+def validate_document_fields(
+    payload: Dict[str, Any],
+    required_fields: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None,
+    min_confidence: float = 0.8,
+) -> ValidationResult:
+    normalized = _normalize_fields(payload)
+    fields = normalized.get("fields", {})
+    if not isinstance(fields, dict):
+        raise TypeError("payload['fields'] must be a mapping")
+    required_fields = tuple(required_fields or ("vendor", "date", "total"))
+    issues = _required_field_issues(fields, required_fields)
+    issues.extend(_confidence_issues(fields, required_fields, min_confidence))
+    valid = len(issues) == 0
+    return ValidationResult(valid=valid, issues=issues, normalized=normalized)
+
+
+def validate_document_fields_with_openai(payload: Dict[str, Any], min_confidence: float = 0.8) -> ValidationResult:
+    api_key = _get_api_key()
+    body = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "Validate structured document extraction output for required fields and confidence scores. Return JSON only.",
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": json.dumps({"payload": payload, "min_confidence": min_confidence}),
+            },
+        ],
+        "response_format": {
+            "type": "json_schema",
+            "json_schema": {
+                "name": "document_validation",
+                "schema": {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {
+                        "valid": {"type": "boolean"},
+                        "issues": {
+                            "type": "array",
+                            "items": {
+                                "type": "object",
+                                "properties": {
+                                    "field": {"type": "string"},
+                                    "code": {"type": "string"},
+                                    "message": {"type": "string"},
+                                },
+                                "required": ["field", "code", "message"],
+                                "additionalProperties": False,
+                            },
+                        },
+                    },
+                    "required": ["valid", "issues"],
+                    "additionalProperties": False,
+                },
+            },
+        },
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        json=body,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    output = data.get("output", [])
+    text = ""
+    for item in output:
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                text += content.get("text", "")
+    parsed = json.loads(text or "{}")
+    issues = [ValidationIssue(**issue) for issue in parsed.get("issues", [])]
+    return ValidationResult(valid=bool(parsed.get("valid", False)), issues=issues, normalized=_normalize_fields(payload))
+

+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_EXPENSE_NORMALIZER_MODEL", "gpt-4.1-mini")
+
+
+def _to_str(value: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return value.strip() or None
+    return str(value).strip() or None
+
+
+def _to_decimal(value: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    if value is None or value == "":
+        return None
+    try:
+        return format(Decimal(str(value)), "f")
+    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError, TypeError):
+        return None
+
+
+def _to_float(value: Any) -> Optional[float]:
+    if value is None or value == "":
+        return None
+    try:
+        return float(value)
+    except (ValueError, TypeError):
+        return None
+
+
+def _normalize_item(item: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "description": _to_str(item.get("description") or item.get("name") or item.get("item")),
+        "quantity": _to_float(item.get("quantity") or item.get("qty")),
+        "unit_price": _to_decimal(item.get("unit_price") or item.get("price") or item.get("unitPrice")),
+        "amount": _to_decimal(item.get("amount") or item.get("total") or item.get("line_total")),
+        "category": _to_str(item.get("category")),
+    }
+
+
+def normalize_expense_fields(extracted: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    items = extracted.get("items") or extracted.get("line_items") or []
+    normalized_items = [
+        _normalize_item(item)
+        for item in items
+        if isinstance(item, dict)
+    ]
+    total = _to_decimal(extracted.get("total") or extracted.get("grand_total") or extracted.get("amount_total"))
+    tax = _to_decimal(extracted.get("tax") or extracted.get("sales_tax") or extracted.get("vat"))
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "1.0",
+        "source": _to_str(extracted.get("source") or extracted.get("document_type") or "expense_document"),
+        "merchant": _to_str(extracted.get("merchant") or extracted.get("vendor") or extracted.get("payee")),
+        "transaction_date": _to_str(extracted.get("date") or extracted.get("transaction_date") or extracted.get("purchase_date")),
+        "currency": _to_str(extracted.get("currency") or extracted.get("currency_code")),
+        "subtotal": _to_decimal(extracted.get("subtotal") or extracted.get("net_total") or extracted.get("pre_tax_total")),
+        "tax": tax,
+        "total": total,
+        "payment_method": _to_str(extracted.get("payment_method") or extracted.get("tender_type")),
+        "invoice_number": _to_str(extracted.get("invoice_number") or extracted.get("receipt_number") or extracted.get("document_number")),
+        "notes": _to_str(extracted.get("notes") or extracted.get("memo") or extracted.get("description")),
+        "items": normalized_items,
+        "confidence": {
+            "merchant": _to_float((extracted.get("confidence") or {}).get("merchant") if isinstance(extracted.get("confidence"), dict) else extracted.get("merchant_confidence")),
+            "transaction_date": _to_float((extracted.get("confidence") or {}).get("transaction_date") if isinstance(extracted.get("confidence"), dict) else extracted.get("date_confidence")),
+            "total": _to_float((extracted.get("confidence") or {}).get("total") if isinstance(extracted.get("confidence"), dict) else extracted.get("total_confidence")),
+        },
+        "normalized_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+    }
+
+
+def normalize_expense_with_openai(extracted: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = OpenAI()
+    prompt = {
+        "role": "user",
+        "content": json.dumps(
+            {
+                "task": "Normalize extracted expense fields into a standard JSON schema.",
+                "schema": {
+                    "schema_version": "1.0",
+                    "source": "string",
+                    "merchant": "string|null",
+                    "transaction_date": "string|null",
+                    "currency": "string|null",
+                    "subtotal": "string|null",
+                    "tax": "string|null",
+                    "total": "string|null",
+                    "payment_method": "string|null",
+                    "invoice_number": "string|null",
+                    "notes": "string|null",
+                    "items": [
+                        {
+                            "description": "string|null",
+                            "quantity": "number|null",
+                            "unit_price": "string|null",
+                            "amount": "string|null",
+                            "category": "string|null",
+                        }
+                    ],
+                    "confidence": {
+                        "merchant": "number|null",
+                        "transaction_date": "number|null",
+                        "total": "number|null",
+                    },
+                    "normalized_at": "string",
+                },
+                "input": extracted,
+            }
+        ),
+    }
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model=OPENAI_MODEL,
+        input=[prompt],
+        response_format={"type": "json_object"},
+    )
+    return json.loads(response.output_text)
+
+
+__all__ = ["normalize_expense_fields", "normalize_expense_with_openai", "OPENAI_MODEL"]

+import json
+import os

+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+

+
+
+def _to_str(value: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return value.strip() or None
+    return str(value).strip() or None
+
+
+def _to_decimal(value: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    if value is None or value == "":
+        return None
+    try:
+        return format(Decimal(str(value)), "f")
+    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError, TypeError):
+        return None
+
+
+def _to_float(value: Any) -> Optional[float]:
+    if value is None or value == "":
+        return None
+    try:
+        return float(value)
+    except (ValueError, TypeError):
+        return None
+
+
+def _normalize_item(item: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "description": _to_str(item.get("description") or item.get("name") or item.get("item")),
+        "quantity": _to_float(item.get("quantity") or item.get("qty")),
+        "unit_price": _to_decimal(item.get("unit_price") or item.get("price") or item.get("unitPrice")),
+        "amount": _to_decimal(item.get("amount") or item.get("total") or item.get("line_total")),
+        "category": _to_str(item.get("category")),
+    }

+    ]

+    tax = _to_decimal(extracted.get("tax") or extracted.get("sales_tax") or extracted.get("vat"))
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "1.0",
+        "source": _to_str(extracted.get("source") or extracted.get("document_type") or "expense_document"),
+        "merchant": _to_str(extracted.get("merchant") or extracted.get("vendor") or extracted.get("payee")),
+        "transaction_date": _to_str(extracted.get("date") or extracted.get("transaction_date") or extracted.get("purchase_date")),
+        "currency": _to_str(extracted.get("currency") or extracted.get("currency_code")),
+        "subtotal": _to_decimal(extracted.get("subtotal") or extracted.get("net_total") or extracted.get("pre_tax_total")),

+                    "schema_version": "1.0",
+                    "source": "string",
+                    "merchant": "string|null",
+                    "transaction_date": "string|null",
+                    "currency": "string|null",
+                    "subtotal": "string|null",
+                    "tax": "string|null",
+                    "total": "string|null",
+                    "payment_method": "string|null",
+                    "invoice_number": "string|null",
+                    "notes": "string|null",
+                    "items": [
+                        {
+                            "description": "string|null",
+                            "quantity": "number|null",
+                            "unit_price": "string|null",
+                            "amount": "string|null",
+                            "category": "string|null",
+                        }
+                    ],
+                    "confidence": {
+                        "merchant": "number|null",
+                        "transaction_date": "number|null",
+                        "total": "number|null",
+                    },
+                    "normalized_at": "string",
+                },
+                "input": extracted,
+            }
+        ),
+    }

+        model=OPENAI_MODEL,
+        input=[prompt],
+        response_format={"type": "json_object"},
+    )
+    return json.loads(response.output_text)
+
+
